attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no asterisk. Nothing in the corpus answers to the name; the monastery's patron, Nicetius of Lyon, whom the page keeps on 2 Απριλίου, has no folder either, so he is named in the life without a link. The page gives 612 for the election and 624 for the death, and the `dates` object carries the death alone. No hymn.
